title: While my guitar gently speaks — Todd Fisher, Philo Ventures
talk_summary: This is a hobbyist demo talk about building a guitar-to-speech/singing audio plugin using pitch detection (YIN), TTS (Piper/Apple), energy-gap and syllable segmentation, vocoding, and a local LLM for conversational responses.

takeaways.what_they_do: Pitch-shifting vocal samples with World is too slow to run live, so they pre-compute the shifted samples and only do cheap mapping at performance time.
takeaways.evidence_quote: this is a very heavy process and so I can't really do that live. I have to effectively pre-bake that

takeaways.technique: Hybrid heuristic + manual override for segmentation
takeaways.what_they_do: Combines energy-gap and syllable-peak heuristics for word boundaries, and when automation is imperfect exposes manual drag-to-edit segments.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I settled on just the ability to go and actually I could drag this and manually edit some of these
